_comment: Config for `bench.py ab --config ab.json [--preset kit-vs-vanilla] [--out DIR] [--dry-run]`.
Relative paths (repo, prompt_file) resolve against this file's directory.
repo: the checkout to measure; it is never written: each run gets `git worktree add --detach` in the system temp dir.
sha or head: the commit every run starts from; a ref in `head` is resolved once and pinned.
model, effort: the same for every arm (arms are not routed). k: repetitions per task and arm (default 3).
seed: fixes the run order shuffle and the bootstrap (default 0). bootstrap_resamples: default 10000.
timeout_s: wall-clock ceiling per run and per verify command. max_turns: passed to `claude -p` (default 80).
allowed_tools: the `--allowedTools` string, identical in every arm.
tasks[].kind: 'review' (gets the findings contract and a VERDICT line; `base` adds the diff for the judges)
or 'change' (`verify` is a shell command run in the worktree after the arm; exit 0 = pass).
{sha} and {base} in a task prompt become the pinned commits. `seeded` lists known defects for
deterministic recall: a finding matches on file, |line - seeded.line| <= window and, when given, category.
arms[]: prompt_template must contain {task}; env and flags apply to that arm only; overlay lists untracked
repo-relative paths copied into the worktree; evidence is a regex the run's transcript must match,
or null for no check (a non-matching run is `invalid-arm`, never scored).
`--preset kit-vs-vanilla` replaces arms with vanilla, kit-neutral, kit-invoked and native.
judges[]: command is an argv that reads the judge prompt on stdin and prints the reply. Use two
model families when you can; one family is allowed and reported as a limitation.
comparisons (optional): judge pairs [[arm, arm], ...]; default: each arm vs vanilla, and kit-invoked vs native.
Every arm shares the user-level ~/.claude setup and anything committed under the repo's .claude/;
only the untracked overlay paths differ between arms.
Each run leaves its transcript under ~/.claude/projects/; delete those dirs after the report if they hold sensitive prompts.
head: HEAD

tasks.prompt: Review the changes between {base} and {sha} (git diff {base}...{sha}). Work only from the diff and the files it touches.
Make the failing test in tests/test_example.py pass without changing the test.

judges._comment: Same-family judge: allowed, reported as a limitation unless a second family is added.
judges.name: claude-judge
